summary.tldr: Requires the Industry Minister to develop and report on a national framework for grocery pricing and unit price display practices.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Industry, with provincial consumer affairs officials, to develop a national framework on grocery pricing and unit price display practices.
Sets out national standards for the grocery retail sector on unit pricing, including the accuracy, usability and accessibility of unit price displays.
Requires the framework to include measures on transparency about price increases, adjustments and fluctuations.
Promotes consumer education across Canada on what unit prices are and how they are used.
Requires a report within 18 months, then a review and second report within five years, with both reports tabled in Parliament and posted online.
